info.summary: GDPR publication consent management and document metadata enrichment for Nextcloud
info.description:
GDPR publication consent management and document metadata enrichment for Nextcloud
DocuDesk provides GDPR-compliant publication consent tracking (Wet Open Overheid) and automatic document metadata enrichment. It integrates with Open Register via events to enrich documents as they are created and updated.
## Key Features
- GDPR publication consent tracking with configurable objection periods - Wet Open Overheid compliance (minimum 4-week objection period) - Automatic language detection for documents - Keyword extraction and topic classification - Event-driven integration with Open Register
**Open Register is required for this app to work**
Requirements can be found [here](https://conduction.gitbook.io/docudesk-nextcloud/installatie)
The Roadmap is available [here](https://github.com/orgs/docudesk/projects/1/views/2)
Create a [bug report](https://github.com/docudesk/.github/issues/new/choose)
Create a [feature request](https://github.com/docudesk/.github/issues/new/choose)
